## About this page

Which types of item the add button offers, and in what order.

#### How it works

**Shown** is the menu as it appears. A type you take out waits under **Hidden** until you add it back. Hiding a type never touches the items you already have of it.

See also [Kinds of item](/guide/how-it-works/#concept-item-kinds), [Item editor](/guide/screens/#screen-editor), [Editor](/guide/settings/editor/).

<a id="setting-add-kinds"></a>

## Add menu

The types the add button offers, in order. The first one is also what <kbd>Ctrl+N</kbd> (<kbd>⌘N</kbd> on a Mac) starts.

#### How it works

Drag a type to move it, or use its arrow to move it down one. The minus button hides it, and its **Add** row under **Hidden** brings it back.

With only one type shown, the add button skips the menu and starts that type.

#### Limits

The last type cannot be hidden.

#### On Android

The types the add button offers, in order.

Drag a type by its handle to move it. The bin hides it, and its **Add** row under **Hidden** brings it back.

The last type cannot be hidden.

In the Standard style, **More types** at the foot of the add menu still lists the hidden ones.

See also [Show all in the usual order](/guide/settings/add/#action-add-show-all), [Kinds of item](/guide/how-it-works/#concept-item-kinds).

<a id="action-add-show-all"></a>

## Show all in the usual order

Puts every type back in the add menu, in the order WM Pass started with.

See also [Add menu](/guide/settings/add/#setting-add-kinds).
